InputClean module RTL: stage1/design.v
InstructionDescribe the interface, parameters, and observable behavior of this clean design. Return a self-contained specification, not RTL implementation code. A separate isolated call will receive your specification.

module CLA_MUSER_ACLA4(
    input Ci,
    input G0, 
    input G1, 
    input G2, 
    input G3, 
    input P0, 
    input P1, 
    input P2, 
    input P3, 
    output C1, 
    output C2, 
    output C3, 
    output GG, 
    output GP
);
   
   wire XLXN_3;
   wire XLXN_36;
   wire XLXN_59;
   wire XLXN_100;
   wire XLXN_105;
   wire XLXN_108;
   wire XLXN_163;
   wire XLXN_164;
   wire XLXN_165;
   
   assign XLXN_3 = P0 & Ci;
   assign XLXN_59 = G0 & P1;
   assign C1 = G0 | XLXN_3;
   assign XLXN_36 = P1 & P0 & Ci;
   assign C2 = G1 | XLXN_59 | XLXN_36;
   assign XLXN_108 = P2 & G1;
   assign XLXN_105 = P2 & P1 & G0;
   assign XLXN_100 = P2 & P1 & P0 & Ci;
   assign C3 = G2 | XLXN_108 | XLXN_105 | XLXN_100;
   assign GP = P3 & P2 & P1 & P0;
   assign XLXN_163 = P3 & P2 & P1 & G0;
   assign XLXN_164 = P3 & P2 & G1;
   assign XLXN_165 = P3 & G2;
   assign GG = G3 | XLXN_165 | XLXN_164 | XLXN_163;

endmodule
STAGE 2

Complete the module

InputThe generated Stage 1 text plus masked module rtl: stage2_template/design.v. Required top module: CLA_MUSER_ACLA4.
InstructionRestore the masked expression in design.v using the specification and retained RTL context. Return the complete corrected RTL with the same top module. Only the default configuration is scored.

Stored wording: stage2_template/TASK.md

OutputComplete RTL module with the masked logic restored.
